requirements.text: Patients can book, cancel, or reschedule appointments online with a calendar view.
Patients receive automated reminders before their appointments.
Patients can flag urgent symptoms during the booking process.
Patients can view a list of eligible medications for repeat prescriptions.
Patients can request refills for their medications with an option to add notes.
Patients receive confirmation of their prescription requests along with an estimated timeline.
GPs must review prescription requests before they are approved.
Patients are notified when test results are available.
Test results are only accessible after clinician review.
Test results must be presented clearly with educational resources.
Secure identity verification, such as two-factor authentication, is required to access test results.
Include a messaging feature for patients to ask questions about their results.
The portal must have simple navigation with large buttons and clear labels.
Text must be readable with adjustable font sizes and high contrast.
Provide step-by-step instructions or video tutorials for key actions.
Include support features like a chatbot or FAQ section.
Implement accessibility options to accommodate all patients.
Enable family access to assist elderly patients in managing their appointments or prescriptions.
Incorporate a feedback mechanism for patients to provide their input on the portal.
The entire system must maintain patient confidentiality and data security.
